grounding.excerpt: *10     The limits begin on the effective date of this permit and lasting through 3 years from the permit effective date.
*11     The limits apply during the period beginning 3 year from the permit effective date
This permit shall become effective on December 1, 2021. This permit and the authorization to discharge shall expire at midnight, November 30, 2026.

rationale: ACCEPT is not supportable: the obligation values do not state which named regime-interval pairing is being asserted, and the packet does not establish a single regime governing the entire FY2025 period_universe. Footnotes *10 and *11 tie different numeric limits (27,664 vs 24,992 lbs/day) to different temporal windows bracketed around three years from the December 1, 2021 effective date, while FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30) spans that transition. REJECT is likewise not supportable: the packet does not identify permit NM0020583 or outfall 001, and boundary phrasing ('lasting through 3 years' vs 'beginning 3 year from') leaves applicability for early FY2025 monthly periods indeterminate. Neither the burden to establish a regime-interval pairing (ACCEPT) nor the burden to establish its falsity (REJECT) is met; uncertainty is left explicit rather than closed negatively.
